summary: Compound: Provider, Trigger, Content. An opaque --ui-bg-emphasis chip rather than an elevated panel, drawn side by side against a Menu on the sheet before it was chosen. Three things came out of building it. (1) MEASURED against @base-ui/react@1.7.0, the primitive supplies neither role="tooltip" nor aria-describedby — a tooltip built on it alone is decoration, visible to a pointer and absent to a screen reader — so this component wires both from one useId. (2) The hover-intent delays are numbers in @/lib/motion rather than --ui-duration-* tokens, because a delay is read by a JavaScript prop and a custom property cannot be, and check:motion grew a rule that rejects a bare number passed to delay/closeDelay/timeout in registry/ui. (3) The sheet draws a tooltip opening over a DISABLED trigger and it cannot: `disabled` suppresses pointer events and removes the element from the tab order, so both paths are closed and the explanation needs a wrapper the caller owns. All three are in the doc; the last two are also rows on the Paper sheet.
